correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed H_n with path vertices and one tip per edge; computed every edge-to-vertex distance by BFS for n=2..8 and independently enumerated all 43,688 graph-vertex subsets in n=2..8, checking resolving signatures against covers of the specified auxiliary graph and confirming exact polynomial counts/minima. The symbolic table of d(w_j,A_i),d(w_j,L_i),d(w_j,R_i) is verified from shortest paths, and the necessary two-witness pairs force auxiliary edges. For sufficiency the proof classifies all nonconsecutive tip-witness supports by block-index piecewise-affine distance differences, reducing to the six displayed boundary pairs (small overlapping cases direct); independently found precisely six boundary configurations for each n=6,7,8,9,12,18,28. The cover polynomial follows exactly by complementation of independent sets and counting free interior path vertices; leading coefficients yield edim ceil(n/2)+1 and minimum counts. Finite exhaustive cases corroborate, but do not replace the general piecewise-affine argument; its case analysis remains the sensitive nonstandard lemma. The original proposed edim=2 is already refuted at n=3.
